newsitem.title: USA: St James Capital Partners has ACR stake.
newsitem.headline: St James Capital Partners has ACR stake.

text.p: ACR Group Inc said on Friday that St. James Capital Partners LP, an investment limited partnership, had acquired a beneficial interest in more than five percent of its common stock.
St. James, which filed a Schedule 13D with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, bought the stock in either private or open market transactions with existing shareholders, ACR said.
In October, ACR entered into an agreement under which St. James would provide financial advisory services to the company and commit $5 million for ACR acquisitions.
St. James said at that time it intended to take an equity position in the company, ACR said.
"St. James has consistently told us that they fully support our business strategy of acquiring smaller HVACR wholesale companies," said ACR President and Chief Executive Offier Alex Trevino.
HVACR companies, like ACR, distribute air-conditioning, heating and refrigeration equipment and supplies.
